fusions.name: Drowned Syllable
fusions.desc: Speaks a word that drops a weight of water on a target up to 7 tiles away, dealing 14 damage, hitting harder the further it travels, up to 1.3 times at full reach, and stunning it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Recited Bead
fusions.desc: Speaks a bead of water into being that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Stilled Surface
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to speak a stilling word that holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Practised Flow
fusions.desc: Each time you inflict a condition, you restore 4 mana. Once every 5 seconds.
